acumen and hands-on technical credibility. 
Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, cyber remediation, and automation (RPA/AI) initiatives, 
improving service delivery, strengthening governance, and driving measurable business outcomes through Agile, Waterfall, and 
hybrid delivery models. 
Recognized for strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication, with the ability to translate 
business strategy and cyber/risk objectives into structured, actionable delivery roadmaps. Extensive experience partnering with 
business leaders, operations, compliance, security, and vendors to modernize processes, enhance customer experience, and 
improve operational efficiency. 
Strong client handling, strategic planning, escalation management, and consistent delivery on time and within budget while 
maintaining high customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance. 
Core strengths: end-to-end project/program governance, Agile & hybrid execution, change management, IT operations & 
cybersecurity leadership, and delivery assurance in regulated banking and financial environments.
